title: Pilk's getting unreasonable

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Great yeah! Hey, I don't mean to hassle you, but did you get the memo? We have a new rule about pets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great yeah! Hey, I don't mean to hassle you, but did you get the memo? We have a new rule about pets.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Hey, I don't wanna be all "I'M-THE-BOSS-HERE" on you, but you really need to keep up with the communications from your landlord - me - or you're in violation of your tenancy agreement. No one wants that! Right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I don't wanna be all "I'M-THE-BOSS-HERE" on you, but you really need to keep up with the communications from your landlord - me - or you're in violation of your tenancy agreement. No one wants that! Right?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Hey, you're in one of my properties, right? I remember you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you're in one of my properties, right? I remember you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Comms are down in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Comms are down in the LUZ.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Comms are down in the LUZ.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Comms are down in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: Look, I'm not here to read you all the rules from the tenancy agreements handbook. That's your responsibility. It's all in there! You got this bud.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm not here to read you all the rules from the tenancy agreements handbook. That's your responsibility. It's all in there! You got this bud.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Where do I get the rulebook?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where do I get the rulebook?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Where do I get the rulebook?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Where do I get the rulebook?

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: You gotta keep up to date with all relevant paperwork. I can't just GET you all the documentation, but you're a clever tenant. You'll figure it out!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You gotta keep up to date with all relevant paperwork. I can't just GET you all the documentation, but you're a clever tenant. You'll figure it out!

nodes.speaker: Pilk Dane
nodes.text: This concludes our business. If you need another appointment to discuss tenancy issues, please consult your tenants guidebook for appointment times and contact details. Hey, have a great day!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This concludes our business. If you need another appointment to discuss tenancy issues, please consult your tenants guidebook for appointment times and contact details. Hey, have a great day!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Since when does one need to have a pet?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Since when does one need to have a pet?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Since when does one need to have a pet?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Since when does one need to have a pet?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You want my advice? Ignore this. By tomorrow he'll have completely forgotten whatever insane requests he's made.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want my advice? Ignore this. By tomorrow he'll have completely forgotten whatever insane requests he's made.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Assuredly. I believe that if it takes any active measures - such as taking any action whatsoever, or even remembering what you have just discussed, this landlord is unlikely to do anything at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Assuredly. I believe that if it takes any active measures - such as taking any action whatsoever, or even remembering what you have just discussed, this landlord is unlikely to do anything at all.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, so I can't have pets?
